style: Original hand-drawn quirky dark-fairytale cartoon matching the reference, thick uneven ink outer contour, two or three broad painted tones; violet-gray chunky stone, three olive moss groups and two plum mushrooms. No realistic texture, tiny cracks, PBR or pixel art.

idle.action: A restrained four-pose idle settling cycle for a living STONE statue facing LEFT: neutral balanced stance, tiny weight shift at shoulder and arm joints, gentle settling, return close to pose1. Stone plates, helmet, shield and mace are RIGID objects with unchanged shapes/size, no breathing inflation or squash/stretch. Both feet remain planted at the identical baseline; never step or lift a foot. Keep asymmetrical amber eyes, one block tooth, three broad moss clumps, exactly two shoulder mushrooms, same short stone mace in front hand and same crooked shield in other hand. Tiny articulated arm/shoulder changes only, no attacks, blinking, sparks, glow effects, scenery or detached pieces. All four full figures must remain completely separated, head/mushrooms/mace/shield/soles entirely within each slot. Seamless fourth-to-first return.
